properties.description: Input arrays and configuration are never modified.
Disabled and unprocessed channels are unchanged.
Unsupported modes return the defined status without conversion.
Invalid limits return their status without conversion.
Successful enabled channels clear their status.
Linear scale uses the correct unipolar or bipolar range.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.j: An ordinal position starting at zero.
atomic_propositions.raw(j): Sampled analogValues at its lower bound+j.
atomic_propositions.scaled(j): loLIM+(raw/27648)*(hiLIM-loLIM) for unipolar; loLIM+((raw+27648)/55296)*(hiLIM-loLIM) for bipolar.
atomic_propositions.preserved(j): The channel retVal/outputValue equal sampled values.
atomic_propositions.readonlyPreserved: analogValues and channel configuration equal all their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.channel output names: Post-scan fields of the channel at the indicated ordinal position.
atomic_propositions.sampledOutputValue(j): The caller-provided outputValue before this scan.
atomic_propositions.measuringMode(j): The sampled measuringMode configuration for ordinal j.
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB008(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
序号j=0..len(channels)-1；仅j<count且enable处理，0<=count<=min两数组长度。非法mode优先报8001，否则hi<=lo报8002，均保留采样outputValue；成功清码，mode0按单极raw/27648或双极(raw+27648)/55296线性映射，mode1/2分别raw/10、raw/100。其他项及配置精确保留，仅成功outputValue使用abs=1e-5、rel=2e-6。
